features.description: Policy amendment: streak-gated eligibility for HIGH matrix_pin findings in the pure convergence policy. Critical severity and conservative-fallback classifications are never eligible; plan_contract stays under the unchanged v1 rule (block unless explicitly waived_with_reason or cleared by a plan edit — the streak rule never applies to it); medium/low handling unchanged.
features.acceptance: a pure clearance_streak helper counts consecutive full-clearance audit rounds ending at the latest round, where a round is full-clearance IFF it had a prior round AND persisted none of its findings — the FIRST round of any ledger is never full-clearance (nothing preceded it to clear), so a ledger whose rounds each cleared their predecessor has a streak of one less than its total round count (pinned worked example: C0 rounds 1-3 -> streak at round 3 is exactly 2, at round 2 exactly 1, at round 1 exactly 0); override events never count toward or reset within the helper's input contract (audit rounds only); convergence_verdict gains the v1.1 rule: a HIGH-severity finding whose auditor-emitted class is matrix_pin is suppressible by a valid waived_matrix_pin_high disposition IFF clearance_streak >= N (N configurable parameter, default 2); eligibility NEVER applies to critical severity, to plan_contract class, to conservative-fallback (unclassified) findings, or below the streak threshold — plan_contract stays governed by the UNCHANGED v1 rule (block unless explicitly waived_with_reason or cleared by a plan edit; the streak rule never applies to it, at any severity); medium/low/advisory handling, accepted_into_plan semantics, and legacy whole-plan override precedence are byte-for-byte unchanged (regression tests); the streak threshold N has exactly ONE source of truth — a single module-level default constant consumed by convergence_verdict, record_disposition validation, and the lock refusal messaging alike, with any override parameter threaded from that one seam (a test asserts the three consumers cannot disagree); verdict_for gains the streak-conditional cell and the exhaustive severity x class matrix test is updated to stay total; the policy remains pure (no I/O beyond arguments).

features.description: Disposition kind + wiring: record waived_matrix_pin_high with mandatory operator confirmation text, fail-closed validation, and a lock refusal message that names streak-unlocked eligibility.
features.acceptance: record_disposition accepts the new waived_matrix_pin_high kind ONLY for a finding whose latest-round severity is high AND class is matrix_pin AND whose ledger streak satisfies clearance_streak >= N — every other combination refuses fail-closed naming the unmet condition; the kind REQUIRES operator confirmation text of at least 20 characters, AND the literal placeholder string printed in refusal output is itself REJECTED by validation, so no copy-paste of the suggested command can succeed without the operator writing real confirmation text (no default text exists anywhere in the code path); the disposition is recorded, mirrored into decisions.jsonl, and invalidated on material recurrence exactly like existing kinds and is a member of the no-audit resolution set; the dontpanic plan disposition CLI passes the new kind through with its reason; when a lock refusal's blocking set includes a high matrix_pin whose streak eligibility is unlocked, the refusal output names the finding id and a runnable disposition command template containing an explicit must-replace reason placeholder; tests cover acceptance, each refusal arm (wrong severity, wrong class, short confirmation, literal-placeholder confirmation, streak too short), CLI passthrough, and the refusal-message naming.

features.description: Dual real-corpus dogfood: replay the C0 live rounds (1-4) and the worktree-isolation-v0 rounds (1-3) — both with auditor-emitted classes — as offline fixtures proving the eligibility AND the discrimination invariants.
features.acceptance: the C0 plan's real sufficiency-rounds ledger (rounds 1-4, auditor-emitted finding_class values) and the worktree-isolation-v0 plan's real ledger (rounds 1-3) are copied verbatim into the test fixture corpus; fixtures assert: C0 round 3's high matrix_pin is streak-eligible (streak=2) while rounds 1-2 are not (streak 0 and 1); C0 round 4 still BLOCKS on its high plan_contract after the fixture test itself records the round-4 matrix_pin disposition as an explicit setup step against a temp plan-evidence dir built from the verbatim ledger (no reliance on committed decisions.jsonl history) — discrimination; worktree round 3 (streak=2) still BLOCKS on its high plan_contract even under v1.1 (negative case: the new policy must not unlock it); a synthetic fallback case — a HIGH finding with no finding_class (conservative fallback) atop a streak >= N — remains BLOCKED and is REFUSED by record_disposition; an end-to-end completion-path test drives the real lock decision path offline against the real C0 round-3 ledger, ORDERED so the new kind is provably the FINAL gate to lock success: step 1 records lawful v1 dispositions for every NON-high blocker (waived_with_reason for the medium plan_contract — the explicit waiver path the unchanged v1 rule provides; v1 kinds for the remaining mediums) and asserts the lock STILL refuses, naming only the eligible high matrix_pin and its unlocked streak eligibility; step 2 records waived_matrix_pin_high with real confirmation text as the LAST action and asserts the SAME lock decision now proceeds — the new disposition alone flipped refusal to success — with zero auditor invocations across the whole test (enforced by the existing autouse guard); a companion negative runs the reverse order (only waived_matrix_pin_high, mediums un-dispositioned) and asserts refusal; the pre-existing nine fixture rounds remain verdict-stable under v1.1. a scope-guard test pins the sufficiency auditor's finding-class instruction block and output schema contract by equality so the v1.1 change provably leaves the auditor prompt, schema, and classifier instructions untouched.
